summary: An early Telnet option, from 1974, for agreeing how a vertical tab character in output is handled. It follows the same pattern as the related tab and formfeed options from the same author. It is historic.

eli5.summary: A vertical tab tells a printer to jump down the page. This note lets two computers agree on who handles that jump and how.
